events.title: Venice captures the whole Genoese fleet off Trapani
events.description: A Venetian fleet under Jacopo Dondulo captured all 27 ships of the Genoese fleet under Lanfranco Borbonino off Trapani, Sicily. The War of Saint Sabas between Genoa and Venice was fought over control of Acre.

events.title: Granada defeats Castile and León at the Battle of Moclín
events.description: Troops of the Emirate of Granada defeated the forces of Castile and León at Moclín, in the battle also called the Disaster of Moclín. Ruled by the Nasrid dynasty, Granada was the last independent Muslim state in Western Europe.
events.html: Troops of the Emirate of Granada defeated the forces of Castile and León at Moclín, in the battle also called the Disaster of Moclín. Ruled by the Nasrid dynasty, Granada was the last independent Muslim state in Western Europe.

events.title: France and Flanders make peace at Athis-sur-Orge
events.description: King Philip IV of France and Robert III of Flanders signed the Treaty of Athis-sur-Orge, ending the Franco-Flemish War after the French victory at Mons-en-Pévèle. It imposed on Flanders a heavy indemnity, acts of penance and the demolition of town fortifications.

events.title: Battle of Bannockburn begins
events.description: On the first day, Robert the Bruce killed the English knight Henry de Bohun in single combat before the armies. Edward II's larger army was routed the next day.
events.html: On the first day, Robert the Bruce killed the English knight Henry de Bohun in single combat before the armies. Edward II's larger army was routed the next day.

events.title: Robert Clive defeats the Nawab of Bengal at Plassey
events.description: Helped by the defection of Mir Jafar, Clive's East India Company troops defeated Siraj ud-Daulah. The victory gave the Company control of Bengal and launched British territorial rule in India.
events.html: Helped by the defection of Mir Jafar, Clive's East India Company troops defeated Siraj ud-Daulah. The victory gave the Company control of Bengal and launched British territorial rule in India.

events.title: June Days uprising erupts in Paris
events.description: Workers rose after the government closed the National Workshops. General Cavaignac crushed them in four days; thousands were killed and many more deported.
events.html: Workers rose after the government closed the National Workshops. General Cavaignac crushed them in four days; thousands were killed and many more deported.

events.title: Christopher Latham Sholes patents a typewriter
events.description: Sholes and his partners received a patent for a 'Type-Writer'. Developed further and sold by Remington, it popularised the QWERTY keyboard and transformed office work.
events.html: Sholes and his partners received a patent for a 'Type-Writer'. Developed further and sold by Remington, it popularised the QWERTY keyboard and transformed office work.

events.title: Nixon approves using the CIA to block the Watergate inquiry
events.description: In a taped conversation, Nixon agreed that the CIA should ask the FBI to halt its investigation. The release of this 'smoking gun' tape in August 1974 forced his resignation.
events.html: In a taped conversation, Nixon agreed that the CIA should ask the FBI to halt its investigation. The release of this 'smoking gun' tape in August 1974 forced his resignation.

events.title: United Kingdom votes to leave the European Union
events.description: In a referendum, 52 per cent voted to leave the EU. Prime Minister David Cameron resigned, and Britain formally left in January 2020.
events.html: In a referendum, 52 per cent voted to leave the EU. Prime Minister David Cameron resigned, and Britain formally left in January 2020.
